meta.name: review-logic
meta.description: This skill should be invoked by a review orchestrator (e.g. `reviewer:self-review`) to review code for logic errors, edge cases, error handling, state management, data integrity, and injection risks.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 审查代码逻辑、边界与安全风险
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你在合并代码前想自动检查逻辑与安全问题
copy.tagline_en: Review code for logic errors, edge cases, and security risks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need an automated logic and security review before merging code.

howto.what: 被调用时,按既定流程审查指定代码,重点检查逻辑错误、边界情况、错误处理、状态管理、数据完整性与注入风险,并输出符合 reviewer-framework 格式的发现报告。
howto.when: 由审查编排器(如 reviewer:self-review)调用时触发;输入可为文件路径或目录,无参数时审查当前工作目录。

say.text: 用 review-logic 审查 src/ 目录下的代码逻辑。
say.note: 会检查该目录的边界情况和错误处理。

say.text: 审查当前工作目录,重点看状态管理和注入风险。
say.note: 按默认规则输出审查报告。

howto.what_en: When invoked, reviews specified code for logic errors, edge cases, error handling, state management, data integrity, and injection risks, reporting findings in the reviewer-framework format.
howto.when_en: Triggered when invoked by a review orchestrator (e.g. reviewer:self-review). Input is file paths or a directory; with no input, reviews the current working directory.

say_en.text: Use review-logic to review the code logic in src/.
say_en.note: Checks edge cases and error handling in that directory.

say_en.text: Review the current working directory, focusing on state management and injection risks.
say_en.note: Outputs a review report per the default rules.
